<!-- Release: v0.5.0 -->

Localica now has configurable navigation tabs and a mini-player that expands into the full player. Search, browsing history, and Back behavior keep your place as you move through your music.

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/14 - Configurable navigation and an expanding player

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.5.0-debug.apk` from **Assets** below (Android 8+).
2. Open the APK and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.
3. Open Localica and choose your music folder in Settings.
